article.title: Tiger Brokers新加坡戶外廣告試用三個AI代理，人員保留審批
article.summary: Adzymic披露一項已完成的實地試點，AI代理協助Tiger Brokers在新加坡規劃戶外投放和製作素材。
highlights: 試點在新加坡逾260塊數碼屏幕投放。
人員保留媒體計劃審批、素材檢查和上線安排。
article.why: 戶外媒體團隊可把版位規劃及素材尺寸調整分開測試，保留商業批准責任。
article.next_step: 挑一組版位，比對代理提出的屏幕清單、素材規格及實際可購庫存。
article.detail: 媒體方Stellar Ace、技術供應商Adzymic與Tiger Brokers在新加坡執行戶外廣告試點。據合作方披露，三個AI代理分工提出媒體計劃、審視庫存和製作適合不同屏幕的素材。Tiger Brokers審閱並批准計劃，媒體方再接受投放，相關團隊也檢查素材並安排正式上線。
article.title_en: Tiger Brokers tests three AI agents in Singapore outdoor ads with human approval
article.summary_en: Adzymic disclosed a completed live pilot in which AI agents helped Tiger Brokers plan outdoor media and prepare creative in Singapore.
highlights_en: The pilot ran on more than 260 digital screens in Singapore.
People retained media-plan approval, creative checks and launch operations.
article.why_en: Outdoor media teams can test inventory planning and creative resizing separately while keeping commercial approvals with staff.
article.next_step_en: Select one set of placements and check the proposed screens and specifications against available inventory.
article.detail_en: Stellar Ace, Adzymic and Tiger Brokers ran the Singapore outdoor advertising pilot. The participants say three agents proposed a media plan, assessed inventory and prepared creative for different screens. Tiger Brokers approved the plan before the media owner accepted the buy. Teams also checked creative and managed delivery.
